nucleotide_frequency.png
Source: tagFreqUniq.txt (combo TagDirs)
Base composition near the start of each read, per library — a pre-TSS-calling check on library quality.
median_tags_per_position.png
Source: tagCountDistribution.txt (combo TagDirs)
Median reads stacked at the same genomic position, per library. Should be close to 1 — higher values mean many reads are just PCR copies of the same original molecule rather than independent biological signal.

A-frequency near the TSS, csRNA vs. sRNA overlaid.

Base composition around the called primary TSS — checks whether the called TSS positions look biologically real.

Per-Replicate QC
Generated from each individual replicate's own TagDir, not the merged combo library above — useful for spotting a problem replicate before it gets averaged away.
read_length_distribution_per_replicate.png
Source: tagLengthDistribution.txt (each individual leaf TagDir)
Read length distribution for each individual replicate — an unusual profile here can be masked once replicates are merged into the combo library above.
nucleotide_frequency_per_replicate.png
Source: tagFreqUniq.txt (each individual leaf TagDir)
Base composition near the start of each read, per individual replicate rather than the merged combo library.
autocorrelation_per_replicate.png
Source: tagAutocorrelation.txt (each individual leaf TagDir)
How reads cluster relative to each other and to strand, per individual replicate rather than the merged combo library.
tagdir_stats_per_replicate.png
Source: tagInfo.txt (each individual leaf TagDir)
Same summary stats as the combo table above, but one row per individual replicate — a low tag count, unusual GC content, or poor median-tags-per-position on one replicate is visible here even though it would be averaged away once merged into the combo.
